recommendation: Keep this commit as the current bounded completion of FHIR-49741. Revisit additive modeling only if FHIR-49881 or another final work-group decision replaces this structure; keep Device.additive.performer and Device.additive.performed removed per FHIR-50160.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO issue for R6 requesting additive 0..* backbones on DeviceDefinition and Device so Specimen.container.device can represent container additives, with additive.type and additive.quantity and, originally, Device-specific performer/performed fields.
initial_application: Commit ead1000d9e, merged by PR #3424, added Device.additive and DeviceDefinition.additive plus FiveWs mapping exceptions. Current source retained Device.additive but DeviceDefinition.additive was missing after PR #3432 merged a DeviceDefinition branch that lacked that new element.
additional_context: Device, DeviceDefinition, and Specimen are active current-build resources in fhir.ini. FHIR-50160 later removed Device.additive.performer and Device.additive.performed and added Procedure guidance, so those original Device sub-elements were intentionally not restored. FHIR-49881 is related but remains Waiting for Input, so it is not a final superseding decision.
reconciliation: Restored DeviceDefinition.additive, DeviceDefinition.additive.type, and DeviceDefinition.additive.quantity in the active DeviceDefinition StructureDefinition, aligned to the current Device.additive shape using CodeableReference(SubstanceDefinition) and SimpleQuantity. Restored the DeviceDefinition FiveWs mapping exception and added fhir.ini R5-to-R6 change entries for the new elements.
source_changes: source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml: restored DeviceDefinition.additive with type and quantity sub-elements.
source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition-fivews-mapping-exceptions.xml: restored the FiveWs.what[x] cardinality exception for DeviceDefinition.additive.
source/fhir.ini: added R5-to-R6 change entries for DeviceDefinition.additive, .type, and .quantity.

related_jiras.note: Applied decision removing Device.additive.performer/performed; constrained this reconciliation not to restore those original seed sub-elements.
Broader Device/DeviceDefinition additive reconsideration remains Waiting for Input and does not supersede FHIR-49741.
Later Device ballot-note issue records Device.additive as an R6 Device change.
